When_a_file_is_created_or_modified_in_th.description: This trigger returns a bare array, so splitOn is @triggerBody(), not ?['value']. Conditions drop lock files, folders and unsupported extensions before a run is consumed.

Route_destination_folder.description: Order matters: contract logs are tested before 'quote log' because their names contain it. Inventory names are case-exact to match the downstream reader; wrong case is quarantined. Large sales extracts are skipped.
